segments.subtask: The robot arm approaches the table with test tubes.
The robot arm grasps the test tube with yellow pigment.
The robot arm lifts the test tube with yellow pigment and moves it to the beaker.
The robot arm pours the yellow pigment into the beaker.
The robot arm places the test tube with yellow pigment back on the table.
The robot arm grasps the test tube with red pigment.
The robot arm lifts the test tube with red pigment and moves it to the beaker.
The robot arm pours the red pigment into the beaker.
The robot arm places the test tube with red pigment back on the table.
The robot arm retracts from the table.
